text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
description: An original chibi animated astronaut companion voice. Bright light feminine mid-high register, compact rounded resonance, softly buoyant and playful. A friendly little adventurous smile with a gentle melodic lift; short clear nimble syllables and relaxed cozy encouragement. Avoid grounded adult alto, authoritative mission announcements, breathy whispering or shouting.
